You are resolving an in-progress git merge in treams-rs (branch claude/treams-rs-improvements-snetmh). It merges commit 1b99015 (condensed into 8251007) ("RB3": planar stacks work in crates/treams-core — smatrix.rs was SPLIT into planar submodules with unchanged public paths, plus layers.rs/plane.rs changes, closed-form propagation composition, conjugate-aware products, forward blocks returned by value, test-only illumination entry points removed, new native planar invariants in properties/planar.rs, Python test trims) into the integration branch. The integration branch already contains RA2, which edited the OLD crates/treams-core/src/smatrix.rs (e.g. it moved view/view_mut/product helpers from interaction.rs into linalg.rs, replaced product_adjoint_left(_view) with .adjoint() at call sites, made iterative::norm pub(crate) and used it in smatrix's internal_iteration instead of a duplicate column norm, and changed interaction/illumination APIs such as a shared Factorization and LocalMatrix as a block list), RA1a (special functions), RB1/RB2, PA1–PA4 (bindings incl. crates/treams-py/src/smatrix.rs rework with shared take_checked/detached helpers and a negative-stride-safe borrowed block path), and the Python test lanes (tests/_support.py, mandatory category markers). Do not abort the merge.

Conflicts (see git status): crates/treams-core/src/smatrix.rs (deleted by RB3 = split into a directory module; modified by RA2), crates/treams-core/src/properties/planar.rs, crates/treams-py/src/smatrix.rs, docs/api.md, docs/status.md, tests/test_internal_bands.py, tests/test_layers.py, tests/test_plane_transforms.py, tests/test_smatrix.py.

How to resolve:

  1. smatrix.rs: accept RB3's split (delete the old file) and PORT every change RA2 made to the old smatrix.rs into the corresponding new submodule(s). Find RA2's changes with git log -p eaddc75 --not 1b99015 -- crates/treams-core/src/smatrix.rs (condensed into 8251007) (condensed into 8251007) (or diff the old file between the merge base and HEAD: git diff $(git merge-base HEAD MERGE_HEAD) HEAD -- crates/treams-core/src/smatrix.rs). Also make RB3's new code compile against the integration branch's changed APIs (linalg::view/product helpers, interaction/illumination/iterative changes). Keep both sides' behaviour; the result must be numerically identical to each side's intent.
  2. properties/planar.rs: keep both sides' properties (RB3's new native planar invariants and anything RA2/others added or moved).
  3. crates/treams-py/src/smatrix.rs: keep PA2's binding structure (shared helpers, negative-stride-safe Operand/borrowed path) and adapt to RB3's core API changes (e.g. removed test-only illumination entry points, forward blocks returned by value).
  4. Tests: keep the test lanes' structure and markers AND RB3's intent (trims where named Rust tests now cover invariants — keep a trim only if that Rust test exists after the merge — plus any new assertions). Every test needs a registered category marker (tests/test_suite_contract.py guard). Strict xfails whose defect RB3 fixed (e.g. identical-media interface identity, or others listed in docs/status.md expected failures) must become plain tests and their status.md entries removed.
  5. docs/status.md: keep both sides' content (additive). docs/api.md is GENERATED: resolve by regenerating with uv run --no-sync python scripts/generate_agent_docs.py after the build; never hand-merge it.

Verification (all must pass before committing): cd treams-rs && just build-ext (cold target), cargo fmt --check --all, PYO3_PYTHON=$PWD/.venv/bin/python cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings, PYO3_PYTHON=$PWD/.venv/bin/python cargo test --locked -p treams-core, RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" PYO3_PYTHON=$PWD/.venv/bin/python cargo doc --workspace --no-deps --locked, .venv/bin/ruff format --check . && .venv/bin/ruff check ., uv run --no-sync pyrefly check, uv run --no-sync python scripts/generate_agent_docs.py --check, the full uv run --no-sync pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider, and PYTHONPATH=$PWD/python .venv/bin/python battery.py compare baseline.npz (must PASS; RB3 and RA2 each passed parity on their own). Commit the merge with message "Merge RB3: planar stacks, S-matrices, interfaces, layers and plane-wave bases" plus a body describing how RA2's smatrix.rs edits were ported into the split modules and the other resolutions, ending with: Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 noreply@anthropic.com Claude-Session: [link to a conversation in the cloud] Do NOT push; do not touch scratch: lanes or other branches. Use a private scratch subdirectory under scratch for logs (other agents share scratch). Report the resolutions and all verification results.

The RB3 merge is resolved and committed as 6967b59 (condensed into 8251007) on claude/treams-rs-improvements-snetmh (parents ea5a211 (condensed into 8251007) and 1b99015 (condensed into 8251007)). It is not pushed, the working tree is clean, and every verification step passed, including parity. Logs are in merge-rb3/.

smatrix.rs. I took RB3's split: the old file is deleted and RA2's edits to it are carried into the new smatrix/ submodules.

  • Helper imports: view, view_mut, product, product_views and product_adjoint_right(_into) now come from linalg instead of interaction, in smatrix/{mod,compose,internal,power}.rs. layers.rs needed the same fix because it still imported interaction::product.
  • Adjoint products: every product_adjoint_left(_view)(a, b) is now product_views(view(a).adjoint(), b). That covers the internal Krylov adjoint and IlluminationResidual::pullback (internal.rs), PeriodicResidual and StackResidual pullbacks (compose.rs), and TransmissionResidual::pullback (power.rs).
  • RB3's new conjugate contraction: in ArrayResidual::pullback, product_adjoint_left_view(view(a).transpose(), b) is now product_views(view(a).conjugate(), b). faer turns both forms into the same conjugated matmul the old helpers called, so results are unchanged.
  • Column norm: internal_iteration uses iterative::norm instead of its duplicate hypot fold.

properties/planar.rs. It is RB3's version, with view now imported from linalg. RB3's internal_illumination_matches_composition replaces RA2's trimmed internal_field_amplitude_adjoint. The RA2 test called smatrix::illuminate and StoredBlock::from_rows, which RB3 removed, and RB3's property checks the same things through the borrowed row-major path.

  • One deliberate drop: RB3 had also moved a fixed 2x2 linear-solve check into properties/linalg.rs (linear_solve_scale_adjoint). RA2 had already folded that check into linalg::tests::solve_and_adjoint_are_invariant_to_equation_and_unknown_units, which ran and passed. I removed RB3's copy as a duplicate, so properties/linalg.rs is identical to HEAD. This is the only place I didn't keep both sides literally.

crates/treams-py/src/smatrix.rs. PA2's structure is kept: take_checked/take/detached, Operand for negative-stride-safe borrowed views, blocks_array and cotangent_blocks. It is adapted to RB3's core API:

  • Forward calls (from_array, add, fresnel, interface, propagation, transmittance) now receive (value, residual).
  • Pullback shape checks use ports(), dimension() and shape() instead of residual.value.
  • Transmittance takes the new PowerPorts struct.
  • The binding only ever called illuminate_borrowed and illuminate_forward, so RB3's removed test-only entry points need no change.

Tests

  • test_smatrix.py, test_internal_bands.py and test_plane_transforms.py end up identical to HEAD. The lane versions already had RB3's switch to check_pullback. assert_one_use_context covers RB3's "consumed" checks, and the LAYOUTS sweep covers its non-contiguous and strided checks, so I dropped RB3's now-unused assert_array_equal import.
  • test_layers.py gains RB3's new test_slab_between_lossless_media_transmits_reciprocally, which I marked @pytest.mark.physics; the lane markers on the next test are kept. The matching Rust property stacks_between_lossless_media_transmit_reciprocally exists and passes.
  • RB3 removed no whole Python tests.
  • No xfail changes. RB3 fixed none of the six listed expected failures; its identical-media interface fix had no xfail, and test_identical_grazing_media_are_transparent still passes as a plain test.

Docs. docs/status.md joins RB3's planar-invariants sentence onto the lanes' native-properties paragraph. docs/api.md was regenerated from the fresh build; the only change is RB3's smatrix_tr docstring line.

Verification (all on the committed tree)

Check Result

cargo fmt --check --all clean
cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -D warnings clean
cargo test --locked -p treams-core 165 passed, 0 failed (all planar properties included)

The 36 skips are missing matplotlib and one "no input shares the output dtype and shape" case. The commit body describes the port and each resolution and ends with the requested Co-Authored-By and Claude-Session lines.
